title: Specfuse Arazzo Extensions (Combined)
description: Composed schema that attaches all Specfuse vendor extensions to the correct Arazzo document, workflow, and step paths. Validates extension properties only — Arazzo native structure is validated by the Arazzo 1.0.1 JSON Schema separately. NOTE: the x-domain value-set is project-defined (declare it in the project's overlay or its Spectral ruleset). This schema enforces the kebab-case shape of x-domain but not the closed list of valid values. See Arazzo Handbook §4-§7.

x-version.description: Lifecycle and status metadata. Required on all Arazzo documents.

x-domain.description: Owning domain. Required on all Arazzo documents.

x-mcp.description: MCP tool exposure declaration. Only valid on scenario documents.

x-actors.description: Actor declarations. Required on scenario documents, forbidden on recipe documents.

x-setup.description: Recipe reference for test fixture provisioning. Only valid on scenario documents.

x-recipe.description: Recipe metadata. Presence marks the document as a recipe; absence marks it as a scenario.

workflows.description: Arazzo workflows with Specfuse step-level extensions

if.description: Document contains x-recipe — apply recipe rules

domain.description: Owning domain. Must be kebab-case. The kit validates the shape only; the closed value-set is project-defined (declared in the project's Spectral overlay or in a project-local domain enum). The reserved value 'cross-domain' is conventionally allowed for files under scenarios/cross-domain/.

dateToken.description: Relative date token resolved at runtime by Specfuse. Syntax: @<anchor>[+-<offset>][@<IANA-timezone>]. Examples: @today+3d, @now-1h30m, @today+2w@America/Montreal

eventName.description: Event name in {Entity}.{Action} PascalCase format, matching AsyncAPI x-label

actorRef.description: Reference to an actor defined in x-actors, using the $actorName convention

recipeDocumentRules.description: Rules for recipe documents: x-actors, x-setup, and x-mcp are forbidden. Steps must not use x-as or x-ui.

workflows.description: Recipe workflows with recipe-specific step constraints

scenarioDocumentRules.description: Rules for scenario documents: x-actors is required. x-recipe is forbidden. Steps must use x-as.

workflows.description: Scenario workflows with scenario-specific step constraints

workflowExtensions.description: Extension properties on an Arazzo workflow object

steps.description: Workflow steps with Specfuse extension properties

scenarioWorkflowExtensions.description: Scenario workflow: steps must carry x-as

steps.description: Scenario steps requiring x-as actor binding

recipeWorkflowExtensions.description: Recipe workflow: steps must not carry x-as, x-ui, or x-async

steps.description: Recipe steps with restricted extension set (x-doc only)

stepExtensions.description: All possible step-level extensions (for generic validation without recipe/scenario context)

x-async.description: Async event-driven interactions for this step

x-ui.description: UI automation hints for this step

scenarioStepExtensions.description: Scenario step extensions: x-as is required

x-as.description: Actor performing this step. Required on all scenario steps.

x-async.description: Async event-driven interactions for this step

x-ui.description: UI automation hints for this step

recipeStepExtensions.description: Recipe step extensions: x-as, x-ui, and x-async are forbidden. Only x-doc is allowed.
